review_scope: Technical review of 23 paired composed physical views after enabling the sheltered precipitation view. The directly witnessed covered and exposed entrance weather is recorded in the installed route case.

images.observation: The same pipe, casing and gauge details read in the warm light. Left fittings remain in shadow.
The bookcase stock and adjacent door remain correctly positioned. Upper shelves stay dark.
Tiles and exposed cistern edge match. Cropping still limits the rear service view.
A close brick surface fills both views. Shadow keeps the mechanism obscured.
The table, wall door and shelf retain their composition. The companion face and tabletop reflection vary slightly.
The circular beam and curtain retain their placement on the tile wall. The seat remains cropped.
The resident and the room furnishings retain their silhouettes and placement. The doorway highlight remains bright.
The floor, chair, window and table remain visible. The companion display changes within the same framing.
The kitchen fixtures and light pool remain legible with the same spatial layout.
The door, fuses and conduits match with the same lighting contrast.
The cat, under-counter supports and floor match. The cushion remains shadowed.
The same cat and portrait remain on the dim shelf.
The canopy retains its bracket and picture framing. It still obscures much of the room.
The brass mail bank and bench retain position and legibility in dim light.
The heater, window shade and desktop objects maintain placement and form. The foreground heater remains partly cropped.
Railings, stairs, door and visible roof text align. Shadow definition is comparable.
The tank and skyline retain the same silhouette. Cloud texture placement varies.
The lit terminal and wall board remain present. The adjacent door position and shadows differ between captures.
Tile surfaces and cistern identity match. A stronger angular shadow still crosses the cistern.
Colored residue and floor remain in the lamp pool. The companion posture and screen vary.
The installed form and floor contact remain visible in the same light. The companion pitch differs slightly.
The toaster, kettle and counter retain their positions. Tiny transient specks differ.
The wall-mounted fixture keeps its display and silhouette in low light.
